abstract: A central problem for K3-type Hodge structures is to determine when the anti-invariant sub-Hodge structure U in H^2_-(X, Q) of a double cover X -> B of a (1, d)-polarized abelian surface, branched along a smooth symmetric divisor D in |2L|_+, is realized by algebraic cycles on abelian varieties, and what monodromy obstructions govern the rank-ten (1, 3) seed V_10. First, we prove odd-d character-orthogonality laws separating multiplicity-space and isotypic ranks under semidirect symmetries, showing why (1, 3) is the minimal odd polarization yielding a K3-type piece of rank at most 10 in the tau = +1 eigenspace. Second, for V_10 and its Kummer double cover, we prove a Fock-space D_5 spinor plethysm and Kulikov nilpotent criterion, a gonality dichotomy on D_bar = D/tau (gonality 5 generically via the 32-codeword Kummer code versus 2 on the product locus), and a Universal k-Tuple Quotient Theorem for D^k/W(D_k). Third, we prove a single-reflection fixed-part criterion and the cubic nodal blow-up law showing that the Gauss parity-selection Prym has non-unipotent stable reduction across nodal degenerations, whereas the conic-bundle Prym A_12 satisfies H^1(A_12, Q) = MC_{-1/2}(U)(1). Fourth, on the product and A_2-polarized E^2 loci, we prove the Klein splitting U = 7 + 3, dihedral enhancement to P^3 with U = 5*1_triv + 1_sgn + 2*2_std, Cl^+(W_Z) = M_4(Q) versus Cl^+(U_5^alg) = M_2((-1,-3)_Q), rational dihedral spinor branching bridged over Q by algebraic Clifford bivectors, interior local monodromy separation along P_cusp = 0, the bidegree-(6, 7)/(6, 6) fibration hierarchy on S, and the unconditional rational Hodge Conjecture in all degrees for all self-powers Z^k and tensor powers U^k on P^3. Constructing a generic rank-ten Kuga-Satake correspondence remains open.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: v3 revision of hodge_conjecture_34 addressing all 4 v2 post-acceptance review notes and all 5 reviewer notes on Theorem 8.2: (1) explicit 8x8 rational matrix representation of Cl^+(U_5^alg) = (-2,-6)_Q x (2,6)_Q = M_2((-1,-3)_Q) and Pin/Spin(S_3^diag) on S_Q(U_5^alg) = Q^8, splitting S_Q(V_10)|_{S_0} = 8*1_triv + 8*1_sgn + 8*2_std over Q and bridged over Q by rational Clifford bivectors in M_8(Q); (2) explicit clarification of det(V_10) = +1 vs. d_signed(V_10) = -1; (3) interior local monodromy proof of W_Z != Lambda^2_0 H^1(C_{2,Z}, Q)(1) along {P_cusp = 0} subset P^3 \ {c_0 = 0} via the D_5(-1) orthogonal vector v_{D_5} = (2,4,6,3,3)^T (v_{D_5}^2 = -12 < 0); (4) exact Picard rank bounds rho(X) >= 9 across P^5 and generic rho(X) = 14 on P^3 via the double octic Z_oct = X/S_3^diag -> P^2 and rank-6 IVHS multiplication surjectivity on (U'_14)^{S_3^diag}; and (5) explicit finite-quotient graph correspondences and unconditional Hodge conjecture for Z^k, U^k, and Z^a x B_Z^b via Floccari [18] and hodge_conjecture_29 v2 [19]; certified by 14/14 SymPy tests in test_13_abelian_double_cover_spin_and_prym_vhs.py.
title: Double Covers of Odd-Polarized Abelian Surfaces: Multiplicity-vs.-Isotypic Rank Laws, Clifford-Spinor Structure, Parity-Selection Pryms, and Product-Locus Quotients
